derivative_policy: 15-point order-3 Savitzky-Golay derivative on 100Hz interpolated position; 0.15s trimmed constant segments
limits: Same encoder underlies actual position and derivative; does not independently verify physical shaft motion
Command timestamps bracket host send API; not wire TX timestamp or motor execution time
Existing datasets move J6 only; J1-J5 are holding and are not matched moving-axis controls
